title: debpalash/OmniVoice-Studio
claim: debpalash/OmniVoice-Studio — Local voice clone, video dubbing, dictation and audiobook maker. The open-source ElevenLabs alternative.
hook: The open-source ElevenLabs — clone a voice, dub a video, make an audiobook, all locally with no per-character bill.
why_good: It folds the whole voice-AI stack — cloning, TTS, dictation, video dubbing, audiobook export — into one local app, turning ElevenLabs' metered API into a private one-time install; ~9k stars in four months tracks the backlash against per-character pricing.
value: Sell a supported desktop and team/self-host edition to podcasters, dubbing studios, publishers and agencies that cannot send client audio to a vendor cloud or stomach per-character fees at scale.
risk: Voice cloning is a moving compliance target — consent, deepfakes — and ElevenLabs owns quality and distribution; staying ahead on local model quality is the whole game.

zh.claim: debpalash/OmniVoice-Studio —— 本地音色克隆、视频配音、听写与有声书制作,开源版 ElevenLabs 替代品。
zh.hook: 开源版 ElevenLabs——克隆音色、给视频配音、做有声书,全部本地运行,不再按字符计费。
zh.why_good: 把整条语音 AI 链路——音色克隆、TTS、听写、视频配音、有声书导出——塞进一个本地 app,把 ElevenLabs 的按量计费 API 变成一次性、私有的本地安装;四个月约 9 千星,正对应大家对「按字符收费」的反弹。
zh.value: 面向播客作者、配音工作室、出版社和代理机构,卖带支持的桌面版与团队/自托管版——他们不能把客户音频传给厂商云,也吃不消规模化的按字符收费。
zh.risk: 音色克隆的合规红线一直在动(授权、深度伪造),而 ElevenLabs 手握质量与渠道;能否在本地把模型质量做到领先,是唯一胜负手。

pick_reason: A clear, monetizable product — a private, self-hostable voice studio — attacking ElevenLabs' metered pricing with a local wedge.
